settings.heading: Pre-Preg Carbon Fiber Protection
settings.subheading: ECE 22.06 certified aerodynamic track helmets constructed from pre-impregnated aerospace carbon fiber.

settings.heading: Tunnel Tested Speed.
settings.body: Developed in specialized wind tunnels to optimize laminar flow, minimizing neck fatigue and helmet drag at track speeds.
